title: Grocery cart API: a PUT that is not safe to retry
name: Grocery cart endpoints

questions.prompt: Customers on flaky mobile connections report that their grocery cart quantities keep growing: setting 'milk' to 2 and having the app retry the request after a timeout leaves them with 4 or 6 litres of milk. The same happens when they re-send the request from the cart page. Fix cart/handlers.js so the tests pass.
